Pure-Go AASM: state machines (states/events/transitions/guards/callbacks), CGO=0 — bound into rbgo. It is a pure-Go (no cgo) reimplementation of Ruby's aasm, mirroring its observable behaviour without any Ruby runtime. It is a standalone, reusable module — the backend bound into go-embedded-ruby by rbgo, the same pattern as go-ruby-yaml — differential-tested against reference Ruby, 100% coverage, CI green across 6 arches and 3 OSes.

  • ready capability complete (exit criteria met, nothing material left)

A faithful pure-Go port of Ruby's aasm, cgo disabled, so it cross-compiles and embeds anywhere. Validated differentially against reference Ruby. It is a standalone, reusable module and the backend bound by rbgo into the sibling org github.com/go-embedded-ruby.

Runs in the browser · WebAssembly. Because it is pure Go with cgo disabled, aasm compiles to WebAssembly — both GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm for the browser and GOOS=wasip1 GOARCH=wasm for WASI runtimes — with no C toolchain and no changes to the code.
